items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الْكِرَامِ صَلَاةً مَوْصُولَةً دَائِمَةَ الِاتِّصَالِ بِدَوَامِ ذِي الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his good and noble family, a blessing joined and continuous, enduring as long as the Possessor of Majesty and Honor endures.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihit-tayyibinal-kirami salatan mawsulatan da'imatal-ittisali bidawami Dhil-Jalali wal-Ikram.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي هُوَ قُطْبُ الْجَلَالَةِ وَشَمْسُ النُّبُوَّةِ وَالرِّسَالَةِ، وَالْهَادِي مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، وَالْمُنْقِذُ مِنَ الْجَهَالَةِ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةَ الِاتِّصَالِ وَالتَّوَالِي، مُتَعَاقِبَةً بِتَعَاقُبِ الْأَيَّامِ وَاللَّيَالِي.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who is the pole of majesty, the sun of prophethood and the message, the guide from misguidance, and the rescuer from ignorance. May Allah bless him and grant him peace with a blessing of continuous and unbroken connection, following one another as the days and nights follow one another.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinil-ladhi huwa qutbul-jalalati wash-shamsun-nubuwwati war-risalah, wal-hadi minadh-dhalalati, wal-munqidhu minal-jahalah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama salatan da'imatal-ittisali wat-tawali, muta'aqibatan bita'aqubil-ayyami wal-layali.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَسَلِّمْ صَلَاةً لَا يُحْصَى لَهَا عَدَدٌ وَلَا يُعَدُّ لَهَا مَدَدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and upon his family, and grant peace, a blessing whose number cannot be counted and whose extent cannot be measured.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinin-nabiyyil-ummiyyi wa 'ala alihi wa sallim salatan la yuhsa laha 'adadun wa la yu'addu laha madad.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُكْرِمُ بِهَا مَثْوَاهُ وَتُبَلِّغُهُ بِهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنَ الشَّفَاعَةِ رِضَاهُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a blessing by which You honor his abode and by which You bring him on the Day of Resurrection to his contentment through intercession.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin salatan tukrimu biha mathwahu wa tuballighuhu biha yawmal-qiyamati minash-shafa'ati ridhah.

lessons.title: As Many as the Regions of the Earth

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْأَقْطَارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ وَرَقِ الْأَشْجَارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ زَبَدِ الْبِحَارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْأَنْهَارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ رَمْلِ الصَّحَارَى وَالْقِفَارِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad as many as the regions of the earth, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family as many as the leaves of the trees, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family as many as the foam of the seas, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the rivers, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family as many as the sand of the deserts and wastelands.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadal-aqtar, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi 'adada waraqil-ashjar, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi 'adada zabadil-bihar, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadal-anhar, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi 'adada ramlis-sahara wal-qifar.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ الْأَبْرَارِ وَالْفُجَّارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا يَخْتَلِفُ بِهِ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ، وَاجْعَلِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلَاتَنَا عَلَيْهِ حِجَابًا مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ وَسَبَبًا لِإِبَاحَةِ دَارِ الْقَرَارِ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ.
items.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family as many as the people of Paradise and the people of the Fire, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family as many as the righteous and the wicked, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family as many as the alternation of night and day, and make, O Allah, our blessing upon him a shield from the punishment of the Fire and a means to be granted the Abode of Settlement. Indeed You are the Mighty, the Forgiving.
items.translit: Wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi 'adada ahlil-jannati wa ahlin-nar, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi 'adadal-abrari wal-fujjar, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi 'adada ma yakhtalifu bihil-laylu wan-nahar, waj'alillahumma salatana 'alayhi hijaban min 'adhabin-nari wa sababan li-ibahati daril-qarar, innaka antal-'azizul-ghaffar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا الْمَنِّ الَّذِي لَا يُكَافَأُ امْتِنَانُهُ، وَالطَّوْلِ الَّذِي لَا يُجَازَى إِنْعَامُهُ وَإِحْسَانُهُ، نَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَلَا نَسْأَلُكَ بِهَا أَحَدًا غَيْرَكَ، أَنْ تُطْلِقَ أَلْسِنَتَنَا بِالنَّجَاحِ، وَتُوَفِّقَنَا لِصَالِحِ الْأَعْمَالِ، وَتَجْعَلَنَا مِنَ الْآمِنِينَ يَوْمَ الرَّجْفَةِ وَالزَّلَازِلِ، يَا ذَا الْعِزَّةِ وَالْجَلَالِ.
items.en: O Allah, O Possessor of favor whose bounty cannot be repaid, and grace whose kindness and beneficence cannot be requited, we ask You by Yourself, and we do not ask by it anyone other than You, to loosen our tongues with success, and grant us success in righteous deeds, and make us among those secure on the day of the great shaking and earthquakes, O Possessor of Might and Majesty.
items.translit: Allahumma ya Dhal-mannil-ladhi la yukafa'u imtinanuhu, wat-tawlil-ladhi la yujaza in'amuhu wa ihsanuhu, nas'aluka bika wa la nas'aluka biha ahadan ghayrak, an tutliqa alsinatana bin-najah, wa tuwaffiqana li-salihil-a'mal, wa taj'alana minal-aminina yawmar-rajfati waz-zalazil, ya Dhal-'izzati wal-jalal.

items.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ يَا نُورَ النُّورِ قَبْلَ الْأَزْمِنَةِ وَالدُّهُورِ، أَنْتَ الْبَاقِي بِلَا زَوَالٍ، الْغَنِيُّ بِلَا مِثَالٍ، الْقُدُّوسُ الطَّاهِرُ الْعَلِيُّ الْقَاهِرُ الَّذِي لَا يُحِيطُ بِهِ مَكَانٌ وَلَا يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَمَانٌ.
items.en: I ask You, O Light of Light before the ages and the eras, You are the Everlasting without ceasing, the Self-Sufficient without equal, the Holy, the Pure, the Most High, the Overpowering, whom no place encompasses and no time contains.
items.translit: As'aluka ya Nuran-nuri qablal-azminati wad-duhur, antal-baqi bila zawal, al-ghaniyyu bila mithal, al-quddusut-tahirul-'aliyyul-qahirul-ladhi la yuhitu bihi makanun wa la yashtamilu 'alayhi zaman.

items.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ الْحُسْنَى كُلِّهَا، وَبِأَعْظَمِ أَسْمَائِكَ إِلَيْكَ وَأَشْرَفِهَا عِنْدَكَ مَنْزِلَةً، وَبِاسْمِكَ الْمَخْزُونِ الْمَكْنُونِ الْجَلِيلِ الْأَجَلِّ الْكَبِيرِ الْأَكْبَرِ الْعَظِيمِ الْأَعْظَمِ الَّذِي تُحِبُّهُ وَتَرْضَى عَمَّنْ دَعَاكَ بِهِ وَتَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ دُعَاءَهُ.
items.en: I ask You by all Your Most Beautiful Names, and by the greatest of Your Names to You and the most honorable of them in rank with You, and by Your treasured, hidden, majestic, most majestic, great, greatest, mighty, mightiest Name which You love, and are pleased with whoever calls upon You by it, and whose prayer You answer.
items.translit: As'aluka bi-asma'ikal-husna kulliha, wa bi-a'zami asma'ika ilayka wa ashrafiha 'indaka manzilatan, wa bismikal-makhzunil-maknunil-jalilil-ajallil-kabiril-akbaril-'azimil-a'zamil-ladhi tuhibbuhu wa tardha 'amman da'aka bihi wa tastajibu lahu du'a'ah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَإِنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، الرَّحْمَٰنَ الرَّحِيمَ، الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ، الدَّيَّانَ الْحَنَّانَ الْمَنَّانَ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You, for I bear witness that You are Allah, there is no god except You, the One, the Only, the Eternal Refuge, who did not beget and was not begotten, and there is none equal to Him. O Allah, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, the Living, the Sustainer, the Judge, the Compassionate, the Bestower.
items.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka fa-inni ashhadu annaka antallahul-ladhi la ilaha illa ant, al-Wahidul-Ahadus-Samadul-ladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad. Allahumma Fatiras-samawati wal-ardhi, 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, ar-Rahmanar-Rahim, al-Hayyal-Qayyum, ad-Dayyanal-Hannanal-Mannan.

lessons.title: Open Our Chests by Blessing Him

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَمْحُوَ مِنْ قَلْبِي كُلَّ مَا تَكْرَهُهُ، وَأَنْ تَحْشُوَ قَلْبِي مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ وَمَعْرِفَتِكَ وَرَهْبَتِكَ وَرَغْبَتِكَ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَالْأَمْنَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ، وَعُطْفْ عَلَيْنَا بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَالْبَرَكَةِ مِنْكَ، وَأَلْهِمْنَا الصَّوَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You to erase from my heart everything You dislike, and to fill my heart with fear of You, knowledge of You, awe of You, and desire for what is with You, and security and well-being, and turn toward us with mercy and blessing from You, and inspire us with what is right and with wisdom.
items.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka an tamhuwa min qalbi kulla ma takrahuh, wa an tahshuwa qalbi min khashyatika wa ma'rifatika wa rahbatika wa raghbatika fima 'indak, wal-amna wal-'afiyah, wa 'utif 'alayna bir-rahmati wal-barakati mink, wa alhimnas-sawaba wal-hikmah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اشْرَحْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ صُدُورَنَا، وَيَسِّرْ بِهَا أُمُورَنَا، وَفَرِّجْ بِهَا هُمُومَنَا، وَاكْشِفْ بِهَا غُمُومَنَا، وَاغْفِرْ بِهَا ذُنُوبَنَا، وَاقْضِ بِهَا دُيُونَنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ بِهَا أَحْوَالَنَا، وَبَلِّغْ بِهَا آمَالَنَا، وَتَقَبَّلْ بِهَا تَوْبَتَنَا، وَاغْسِلْ بِهَا حَوْبَتَنَا، وَانْصُرْ بِهَا حُجَّتَنَا، وَطَهِّرْ بِهَا أَلْسِنَتَنَا، وَآنِسْ بِهَا وَحْشَتَنَا، وَارْحَمْ بِهَا غُرْبَتَنَا.
items.en: O Allah, open our chests by sending blessings upon him, and ease our affairs by it, and relieve our worries by it, and remove our sorrows by it, and forgive our sins by it, and settle our debts by it, and set right our states by it, and bring our hopes to fulfillment by it, and accept our repentance by it, and wash away our sin by it, and support our argument by it, and purify our tongues by it, and comfort our loneliness by it, and have mercy on our estrangement by it.
items.translit: Allahummashrah bis-salati 'alayhi sudurana, wa yassir biha umurana, wa farrij biha humumana, wakshif biha ghumumana, waghfir biha dhunubana, waqdhi biha duyunana, wa aslih biha ahwalana, wa balligh biha amalana, wa taqabbal biha tawbatana, waghsil biha hawbatana, wansur biha hujjatana, wa tahhir biha alsinatana, wa anis biha wahshatana, warham biha ghurbatana.

items.ar: وَاجْعَلْهَا نُورًا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا، وَعَنْ أَيْمَانِنَا وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِنَا وَمِنْ تَحْتِنَا، وَفِي حَيَاتِنَا وَمَمَاتِنَا وَفِي قُبُورِنَا وَحَشْرِنَا وَنَشْرِنَا، وَظِلًّا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى رُءُوسِنَا، وَثَقِّلْ بِهَا مَوَازِينَ حَسَنَاتِنَا، وَأَدِمْ بَرَكَاتِهَا عَلَيْنَا حَتَّى نَلْقَى نَبِيَّنَا وَسَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَنَحْنُ آمِنُونَ مُطْمَئِنُّونَ فَرِحُونَ مُسْتَبْشِرُونَ.
items.en: And make it a light before us and behind us, on our right and on our left, above us and below us, in our life and our death and in our graves and our gathering and our resurrection, and a shade over our heads on the Day of Resurrection, and make heavy by it the scales of our good deeds, and make its blessings endure upon us until we meet our Prophet and our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him, his family, and grant him peace, while we are secure, at ease, joyful, and glad.
items.translit: Waj'alha nuran bayna aydina wa min khalfina, wa 'an aymanina wa 'an shama'ilina, wa min fawqina wa min tahtina, wa fi hayatina wa mamatina wa fi quburina wa hashrina wa nashrina, wa zhillan yawmal-qiyamati 'ala ru'usina, wa thaqqil biha mawazina hasanatina, wa adim barakatiha 'alayna hatta nalqa nabiyyana wa Sayyidana Muhammadan sallallahu 'alayhi wa alihi wa sallama wa nahnu aminuna mutma'innuna farihuna mustabshirun.

lessons.title: We Complain to You of Our Hearts

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا آمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَمْ نَرَهُ، فَمَتِّعْنَا فِي الدَّارَيْنِ بِرُؤْيَتِهِ، وَثَبِّتْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى مَحَبَّتِهِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا عَلَى سُنَّتِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ النَّاجِيَةِ وَحِزْبِهِ الْمُفْلِحِينَ، وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَا طَوَتْ عَلَيْهِ قُلُوبُنَا مِنْ مَحَبَّتِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
items.en: O Allah, indeed we have believed in him without having seen him, so grant us in both abodes the enjoyment of seeing him, and steady our hearts upon love of him, and employ us by his way, and take our souls upon his religion, and gather us in his saved company and his successful party, and benefit us by what our hearts have folded within them of love for him, may Allah bless him and grant him peace.
items.translit: Allahumma inna amanna bihi wa lam narahu, fa-matti'na fid-darayni bi-ru'yatihi, wa thabbit qulubana 'ala mahabbatihi, wasta'milna 'ala sunnatihi, wa tawaffana 'ala millatihi, wahshurna fi zumratihin-najiyati wa hizbihil-muflihin, wanfa'na bima tawat 'alayhi qulubuna min mahabbatihi sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam.

items.ar: وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ الْأَصْفَى، وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ الْأَوْفَى، وَيَسِّرْ عَلَيْنَا زِيَارَةَ حَرَمِكَ وَحَرَمِهِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تُمِيتَنَا، وَأَدِمْ عَلَيْنَا الْإِقَامَةَ بِحَرَمِكَ وَحَرَمِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى أَنْ نَتَوَفَّى.
items.en: And bring us to his purest Pool, and give us to drink from his most complete cup, and make it easy for us to visit Your sacred precinct and his before You cause us to die, and make our residence at Your sacred precinct and his, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, endure until we pass away.
items.translit: Wa awridna hawdhahul-asfa, wasqina bika'sihil-awfa, wa yassir 'alayna ziyarata haramika wa haramihi min qabli an tumitana, wa adim 'alaynal-iqamata bi-haramika wa haramihi sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama ila an natawaffa.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَشْفِعُ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ إِذْ هُوَ أَوْجَهُ الشُّفَعَاءِ عِنْدَكَ، وَنَتَوَسَّلُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ إِذْ هُوَ أَعْظَمُ مَنْ أُقْسِمَ بِحَقِّهِ عَلَيْكَ، وَنَتَوَجَّهُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ إِذْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ الْوَسَائِلِ إِلَيْكَ.
items.en: O Allah, indeed we seek intercession through him with You, since he is the most eminent of intercessors with You, and we seek nearness through him to You, since he is the greatest of those by whose right one may swear before You, and we turn through him toward You, since he is the closest of means to You.
items.translit: Allahumma inna nastashfi'u bihi 'alayka idh huwa awjahush-shufa'a'i 'indak, wa natawassalu bihi ilayka idh huwa a'zamu man uqsima bi-haqqihi 'alayk, wa natawajjahu bihi ilayka idh huwa aqrabul-wasa'ili ilayk.

items.ar: نَشْكُو إِلَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ قَسْوَةَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَكَثْرَةَ ذُنُوبِنَا، وَطُولَ آمَالِنَا، وَفَسَادَ أَعْمَالِنَا، وَتَكَاسُلَنَا عَنِ الطَّاعَاتِ، وَهُجُومَنَا عَلَى الْمُخَالَفَاتِ، فَنِعْمَ الْمُشْتَكَى إِلَيْهِ أَنْتَ يَا رَبِّ، بِكَ نَسْتَنْصِرُ عَلَى أَعْدَائِنَا، وَعَلَى أَنْفُسِنَا فَانْصُرْنَا.
items.en: We complain to You, our Lord, of the hardness of our hearts, the multitude of our sins, the length of our hopes, the corruption of our deeds, our laziness toward acts of obedience, and our rushing into transgressions. How excellent a recourse You are, our Lord! By You we seek victory over our enemies, and over our own selves, so grant us victory.
items.translit: Nashku ilayka ya Rabbi qaswata qulubina, wa kathrata dhunubina, wa tula amalina, wa fasada a'malina, wa takasulana 'anit-ta'at, wa hujumana 'alal-mukhalafat, fa-ni'mal-mushtaka ilayhi anta ya Rabbi, bika nastansiru 'ala a'da'ina, wa 'ala anfusina fansurna.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْ تَضَرُّعَنَا وَآمِنْ خَوْفَنَا، وَتَقَبَّلْ أَعْمَالَنَا وَأَصْلِحْ أَحْوَالَنَا، وَاجْعَلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ اشْتِغَالَنَا، وَإِلَى الْخَيْرِ مَآلَنَا، وَحَقِّقْ بِزِيَادَةِ الْإِيمَانِ آمَالَنَا، وَاخْتِمْ بِالسَّعَادَةِ آجَالَنَا. هَذَا ذُلُّنَا ظَاهِرٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، وَحَالُنَا لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ، فَاعْفُ عَنَّا يَا خَيْرَ مَأْمُولٍ وَأَكْرَمَ مَسْئُولٍ، إِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, have mercy on our supplication, secure us from our fear, accept our deeds, set right our states, make our occupation Your obedience, and our outcome the good, and make our hopes real through increase of faith, and seal our terms with happiness. This is our lowliness, manifest before You, and our state is not hidden from You, so pardon us, O Best of those hoped in and Most Generous of those asked, indeed You are Forgiving, Merciful, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
items.translit: Allahummar-ham tadharru'ana wa amin khawfana, wa taqabbal a'malana wa aslih ahwalana, waj'al bi-ta'atikash-tighalana, wa ilal-khayri ma'alana, wa haqqiq bi-ziyadatil-imani amalana, wakhtim bis-sa'adati ajalana. Hadha dhulluna zhahirun bayna yadayk, wa haluna la yakhfa 'alayk, fa'fu 'anna ya khayra ma'mulin wa akrama mas'ul, innaka Ghafurur-Rahim, ya Arhamar-Rahimin.

items.ar: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
items.en: And may Allah's blessings be upon our master Muhammad and upon his family and companions, and grant abundant peace, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
items.translit: Wa sallallahu 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallama tasliman, wal-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin.

items.ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ، وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
items.en: Glory to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they attribute to Him! And peace be upon the messengers, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
items.translit: Subhana Rabbika Rabbil-'izzati 'amma yasifun, wa salamun 'alal-mursalin, wal-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تَقْبَلُ بِهَا دُعَاءَنَا، اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تَسْمَعُ بِهَا اسْتِغَاثَتَنَا وَنِدَاءَنَا، اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُسَلِّمُ بِهَا إِيمَانَنَا، اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُقَوِّي بِهَا إِيقَانَنَا.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You accept our prayer; O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You hear our cry for help and our call; O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You keep our faith safe; O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You strengthen our certainty.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin salatan taqbalu biha du'a'ana, Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin salatan tasma'u biha istighathatana wa nida'ana, Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin salatan tusallimu biha imanana, Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin salatan tuqawwi biha iqanana.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تَغْفِرُ بِهَا ذُنُوبَنَا، وَتَسْتُرُ بِهَا عُيُوبَنَا، وَتَحْفَظُنَا بِهَا مِنِ اكْتِسَابِ السَّيِّئَاتِ، وَتُوَفِّقُنَا بِهَا لِعَمَلِ الصَّالِحَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You forgive our sins, and cover our faults, and protect us from committing wrongdoings, and grant us success in doing righteous deeds.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin salatan taghfiru biha dhunubana, wa tasturu biha 'uyubana, wa tahfazuna biha min iktisabis-sayyi'at, wa tuwaffiquna biha li-'amalis-salihat.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُجَنِّبُ بِهَا عَنَّا الشَّرَّ كُلَّهُ، وَتَمْنَحُنَا بِهَا الْخَيْرَ كُلَّهُ، وَتُصْلِحُ بِهَا أَحْوَالَنَا، وَتَعْصِمُنَا بِهَا عَنِ الْمَعْصِيَةِ وَالْغَوَايَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You turn away from us all evil, and grant us by it all good, and set right our states by it, and protect us by it from disobedience and error.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin salatan tujannibu biha 'anna-sh-sharra kullahu, wa tamnahuna bihal-khayra kullahu, wa tuslihu biha ahwalana, wa ta'simuna biha 'anil-ma'siyati wal-ghawayah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا، وَصَلَاةً تَحْفَظُنَا بِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَدِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَتُصَفِّي بِهَا نُفُوسَنَا مِنَ الْهَوَى، وَتُطَهِّرُ بِهَا مِنْ سِوَاكَ قُلُوبَنَا.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing that pleases You and pleases him and through which You are pleased with us, and a blessing by which You protect us from envy and arrogance, and by which You purify our souls from vain desire, and by which You cleanse our hearts of all but You.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin salatan turdhika wa turdhihi wa tardha biha 'anna, wa salatan tahfazuna biha minal-hasadi wal-kibriya', wa tusaffi biha nufusana minal-hawa, wa tutahhiru biha min siwaka qulubana.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُهَوِّنُ بِهَا عَلَيْنَا سَكَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ وَغَمَرَاتِهِ، وَتُجِيرُنَا بِهَا مِنْ وَحْشَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَكُرْبَتِهِ، وَتَمْلَأُ بِهَا قُبُورَنَا بِأَنْوَارِ الرَّحْمَةِ، وَتَجْعَلُ بِهَا قُبُورَنَا رَوْضَةً مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You ease for us the agonies of death and its throes, and by which You grant us refuge from the desolation of the grave and its distress, and by which You fill our graves with the lights of mercy, and by which You make our graves a garden among the gardens of Paradise.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin salatan tuhawwinu biha 'alayna sakaratil-mawti wa ghamaratih, wa tujiruna biha min wahshatil-qabri wa kurbatih, wa tamla'u biha quburana bi-anwarir-rahmah, wa taj'alu biha quburana rawdhatan min riyadhil-jannah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تَحْشُرُنَا بِهَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ، وَتَبْعَثُنَا بِهَا مَعَ الشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، وَتُثَقِّلُ بِهَا مِيزَانَنَا، وَتُثَبِّتُ بِهَا عَلَى الصِّرَاطِ أَقْدَامَنَا، وَتُدْخِلُنَا بِهَا جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ بِلَا حِسَابٍ، فَاغْفِرْ ذُنُوبَنَا وَاسْتُرْ عُيُوبَنَا يَا رَحِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا حَلِيمُ، وَارْحَمْنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You gather us with the prophets and the truthful, and by which You raise us with the martyrs and the righteous, and by which You make heavy our scale, and by which You steady our feet upon the Bridge, and by which You admit us to the Gardens of Bliss without reckoning. So forgive our sins and cover our faults, O Merciful, O Generous, O Forbearing, and have mercy on us, indeed You have power over all things.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin salatan tahshuruna biha ma'an-nabiyyina was-siddiqin, wa tab'athuna biha ma'ash-shuhada'i was-salihin, wa tuthaqqilu biha mizanana, wa tuthabbitu biha 'alas-sirati aqdamana, wa tudkhiluna biha jannatin-na'imi bila hisab, faghfir dhunubana wastur 'uyubana ya Rahimu ya Karimu ya Halim, warhamna innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا عَبِيدُكَ وَجُنْدٌ مِنْ جُنُودِكَ، مُتَعَلِّقُونَ بِجَنَابِ نَبِيِّكَ، مُتَشَفِّعُونَ إِلَيْكَ بِحَبِيبِكَ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَإِمَامِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَرَضِيَ عَنْ آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, we are Your servants and an army among Your armies, attached to the presence of Your Prophet, seeking his intercession before You, O Lord of the worlds. And may Allah bless our master and prophet Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets and the Leader of the Messengers, and be pleased with his family and all his companions.
items.translit: Allahumma inna 'abiduka wa jundun min junudik, muta'alliquna bi-janabi nabiyyik, mutashaffi'una ilayka bi-habibik, ya Rabbal-'alamin, wa sallallahu 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin khatamin-nabiyyina wa imamil-mursalin, wa radhiya 'an alihi wa sahbihi ajma'in.

items.ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ، وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
items.en: Glory to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they attribute to Him! And peace be upon the messengers, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
items.translit: Subhana Rabbika Rabbil-'izzati 'amma yasifun, wa salamun 'alal-mursalin, wal-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin.
